title: Computing a Home-Site Lease Late Fee: Ledger Bulletin
content:
**Accounting bulletin — amount of a Home-Site Lease late fee for one billing period**

The late fee is defined on the billing period of the most recent rent charge on the lease's rent ledger.

1. **Due date.** The date of that rent charge.
2. **Grace period.** The lot class's grace days, counted in calendar days after the due date; the last of those days is the last grace day.
3. **Period charges.** The period's rent and occupant charges less its rent credits.
4. **Latest payment.** The single most recent payment received on the lease, with its amount and the date received.
5. **Unpaid amount.** The period charges less the latest payment when that payment was received from the due date through the last grace day — but never more than the lease balance at the end of the last grace day, which is the balance now plus the latest payment when that payment was received after the last grace day. The unpaid amount is never below zero.
6. **Percentage fee.** The lot class's late-fee percentage of the unpaid amount, rounded half up to the cent and raised to the lot class's late-fee minimum, charged once.
7. **Late fee.** The amount so found, capped at the lot class's late-fee maximum and rounded half up to the cent. At most one late fee is charged per billing period.

The cap acts on the amount after the minimum has been applied.

### Worked figures (hypothetical lot class figures: grace of 5 days, late-fee percentage 6.0, minimum 30.00, maximum 80.00; rent due on the 1st, last grace day the 6th)

Period charges in every case: rent 700.00 plus occupant charge 30.00 less a rent credit of 15.00, that is 715.00.

| Case | Latest payment | Balance now | Balance at end of the last grace day | Unpaid amount | Percentage fee | Late fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 300.00 received on the 4th | 415.00 | 415.00 | the lesser of 415.00 and 415.00: 415.00 | 6.0 percent is 24.90, raised to 30.00 | 30.00 |
| B | 500.00 received on the 9th | 215.00 | 215.00 plus 500.00: 715.00 | the lesser of 715.00 and 715.00: 715.00 | 42.90 | 42.90 |
| C | none since a credit balance of 200.00 | 515.00 | 515.00 | the lesser of 715.00 and 515.00: 515.00 | 30.90 | 30.90 |
| D | none; earlier periods also unpaid | 2,145.00 | 2,145.00 | the lesser of 715.00 and 2,145.00: 715.00 | 42.90 | 42.90 |

In case A the payment fell inside the grace period and reduces the period charges; in case B it came after the last grace day, so it is added back to find the balance at the end of the last grace day. In case D the period charges, not the larger balance, set the unpaid amount.

*Cap illustration (hypothetical).* An unpaid amount of 1,450.00 at 6.0 percent gives 87.00, capped at 80.00.
